items.q: What is the area of a triangle?
items.why: The ½ is essential; a triangle is half the rectangle around it.

items.q: What units is volume measured in?
items.why: Length is cm, area is cm², volume is cm³.

items.q: What is the area of a circle?
items.why: πr² is the area; 2πr (= πd) is the circumference.
